subject: Renewal + capacity uplift: procurement portal steps and vendor re‑onboarding
messages:
From: Erin Blake <erin.blake@globex.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal: procurement portal & vendor re-onboarding for capacity uplift

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the heads-up on the renewal conversation. Globex is targeting a 25% capacity uplift starting in July and we want to get procurement and vendor re-onboarding completed by mid‑June so the POD onboarding team can schedule capacity the week of 7/6.

Attached is our initial requirements form and estimated commit (see: Globex_Req_Form.pdf). High-level asks: 
- Confirm Redwood's procurement portal invite and vendor re-onboarding checklist so we can submit evidence in one place.
- Confirm timeline to receive an updated SOW + PO template (we prefer net-45).
- Any pre-approved SLA amendments or credit notes you can share for a term change?

Can you share next steps & a rough timeline (portal invite, evidence checklist, who owns W9/tax info)? Happy to loop in our procurement mailbox (procurement@globex.com) if that helps.

Thanks —
Erin Blake
Senior Procurement Manager
Globex Corporation
Attachment: Globex_Req_Form.pdf (pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Erin Blake <erin.blake@globex.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement portal & vendor re-onboarding for capacity uplift

Erin —

Appreciate the detail. Welcome the 25% uplift — we can support that with a staged capacity rollout. Below is a quick mutual action plan so we have clear owners and dates.

Mutual action plan (draft)
- Today (5/18): Redwood sends vendor portal invite + onboarding checklist (we'll attach the spreadsheet). Owner: Aditya.
- 5/20: Globex returns completed requirements + W9/tax docs. Owner: Globex procurement.
- 5/21–5/25: Redwood procurement & legal review payment terms and attach acceptability matrix. Owner: Laura (procurement), Jonas (legal).
- 5/26: PO issued by Globex (target). Once PO is in, we schedule onboarding kickoff.

Links / attachments I’m sharing:
- Vendor_Onboard_Checklist.xlsx (checklist + evidence buckets)
- Evidence_Guide.md (what to upload to vendor portal and recommended filenames)
- Vendor portal invite: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/invite?token=abc123
- DocuSign (SLA amendment power form): https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=0a1b2c3d

A few things to note: we can accept net-45 but Laura will confirm any exceptions; procurement portal is where we consolidate SOC/Security evidence to speed re‑onboarding (no need to email PDFs if you can upload).

If that plan looks good, I'll mark items and loop our finance team for PO receipt automation.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vendor_Onboard_Checklist.xlsx, Evidence_Guide.md
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Hi Erin / Aditya —

Thanks — quick procurement note to keep the timeline tight:
- Please upload the signed requirements form and W9 into the vendor portal by 5/20 so we can skip manual processing. If you must email, send to procurement@redwood.com and copy me.
- Our acceptance matrix is attached (procure-acceptance-matrix.pdf). Key gating items are tax docs, SOC2 evidence (if any changes), and final payment term confirmation.
- If Globex needs a PO template changed (billing address, remit instructions), flag it today so we can avoid back-and-forth.

We will attempt an accelerated review (48–72 hours) once all artifacts are in the portal. If anything looks off during review, we will raise an evidence request in the portal and loop Globex procurement.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
